title: Malmgren links his life and his knowledge at MIT to time travel

tellings.quote: I've thought about this many many times and the answer is yes. Nothing else explains when I told you to MIT professor I didn't have the slightest inhibition

plain: Harold Malmgren, a former advisor to US presidents, says that looking back on his life, including things he knew and said as a young man around MIT, the Massachusetts university, in the 1950s, the only explanation he can find is time travel. He says he has "thought about this many many times and the answer is yes," pointing to how freely he spoke to an MIT professor: "I didn't have the slightest inhibition." If true, it would mean his knowledge came from somewhere outside ordinary time.
